# Third-party components

Generated by `tools/vendor.py` from `vendor/vendor.json`. Each folder keeps the
upstream LICENSE/NOTICE file next to the distributed build. `python3 tools/vendor.py --check`
verifies every shipped file against the sha256 recorded in `vendor/vendor.json`.

| id | package | version | license | upstream | used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `echarts` | `echarts` | 6.1.0 | Apache-2.0 | https://github.com/apache/echarts | Primary chart engine (40+ series types, dataZoom, brush, geo, sankey, treemap...) |
| `leaflet` | `leaflet` | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet | Interactive maps: choropleth, proportional symbols, flows, clusters |
| `leaflet-markercluster` | `leaflet.markercluster` | 1.5.3 | MIT | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.markercluster | Marker clustering for dense point layers |
| `leaflet-heat` | `leaflet.heat` | 0.2.0 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/Leaflet/Leaflet.heat | Canvas density heatmap layer |
| `topojson-client` | `topojson-client` | 3.1.0 | ISC | https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client | TopoJSON -> GeoJSON in the browser |
| `world-atlas` | `world-atlas` | 2.0.2 | ISC (data: Natural Earth, public domain) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas | Offline world basemap (country polygons, ISO numeric ids) |
| `tabulator` | `tabulator-tables` | 6.6.1 | MIT | https://github.com/olifolkerd/tabulator | Interactive data grid (sort, filter, group, freeze, export) |
| `geo-world` | `(generated from world-atlas by tools/build_geo.py)` | world-atlas 2.0.2 | ISC (data: Natural Earth, public domain) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas | Offline world basemap as a classic script: RK.geo.register('world-110m', topojson) |
| `geo-world-50m` | `(generated from world-atlas by tools/build_geo.py)` | world-atlas 2.0.2 | ISC (data: Natural Earth, public domain) | https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas | Higher-detail (1:50m) offline world basemap: RK.geo.register('world-50m', topojson); shipped only when a map block sets basemap: 'world-50m' (manifest optionDeps) |
| `font-inter` | `@fontsource/inter` | 5.3.0 | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/rsms/inter | UI / body / numbers (tabular figures) — bundled for offline use |
| `font-source-serif-4` | `@fontsource/source-serif-4` | 5.3.1 | OFL-1.1 | https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-serif | Action titles / headings (pitchbook serif) |
